# MathTable

Qualified name: `manim.mobject.table.MathTable`

class MathTable(*table*, *element\_to\_mobject=<class 'manim.mobject.text.tex\_mobject.MathTex'>*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table")

    A specialized [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table") mobject for use with LaTeX.

    Examples

    Example: MathTableExample

    ![../_images/MathTableExample-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/MathTableExample-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class MathTableExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            t0 = MathTable(
                [["+", 0, 5, 10],
                [0, 0, 5, 10],
                [2, 2, 7, 12],
                [4, 4, 9, 14]],
                include_outer_lines=True)
            self.add(t0)
    ```

    Special case of [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table") with element\_to\_mobject set to [`MathTex`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.MathTex.html#manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.MathTex "manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.MathTex").
    Every entry in table is set in a Latex align environment.

    Parameters:
    :   - **table** (*Iterable**[**Iterable**[**float* *|* *str**]**]*) – A non-empty, finite iterable of equally sized iterables. The content
